title: Your business is a pizza. What is the topping?
intro: It is a silly question that gets an honest answer, which is the whole trick of a good one.
og_line: Five questions and the topping your business has been all along.

cta.title: Something a bit more serious
cta.label: The Energy Discovery
cta.blurb: That one was for fun. The Energy Discovery is 48 statements and returns how you actually work across all twelve energies.

questions.q: Explain your business in one sentence.

options.a: Easy. People already know what it is
I can, but people argue with it
It takes me two sentences, honestly
I have never managed it in one
They were already looking for it
Somebody told them it was mad

questions.q: What do people say when you describe it?

options.a: So which part is the business?
Plenty, and I know them all
Almost none, which worries me slightly

results.name: Pepperoni
results.headline: Traditional, and it works.
results.body: You are doing a known thing properly. There is no mystery to explain and no education to fund, which is worth more than founders admit.
results.cost: Anybody can order the same thing, so the only edge you have is doing it better.

results.name: Pineapple
results.headline: Bold, and people have opinions.
results.body: Half the room thinks you are wrong and the other half is extremely loyal. There is no version of this that everyone likes.
results.cost: You spend real energy defending the choice instead of improving it.

results.name: Mushrooms
results.headline: Quiet, and better than it looks.
results.body: You are not the obvious pick and the people who choose you keep choosing you. Word of mouth is doing most of your marketing.
results.cost: Quiet does not scale on its own. Somebody has to say it out loud.

results.name: Everything on it
results.headline: Serial entrepreneur energy.
results.body: You said yes to all of it. There is a version of this that is range and a version that is indecision, and only you know which.
results.cost: Every extra topping makes the thing harder to describe in one sentence.
